You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 785171fd6cd7dcd7ada5a733b6a2d44ec566c3a0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lars-Peter Clausen <lars@metafoo.de>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2015 14:56:28 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] iio:ad7793: Fix ad7785 product ID

While the datasheet for the AD7785 lists 0xXB as the product ID the actual
product ID is 0xX3.

Fix the product ID otherwise the driver will reject the device due to non
matching IDs.

Fixes: e786cc26dcc5 ("staging:iio:ad7793: Implement stricter id checking")
Signed-off-by: Lars-Peter Clausen <lars@metafoo.de>
Cc: <Stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <jic23@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/iio/adc/ad7793.c b/drivers/iio/adc/ad7793.c
index b84922a4b32e..710aee8377bb 100644
--- a/drivers/iio/adc/ad7793.c
+++ b/drivers/iio/adc/ad7793.c
@@ -101,7 +101,7 @@
 #define AD7795_CH_AIN1M_AIN1M	8 /* AIN1(-) - AIN1(-) */
 
 /* ID Register Bit Designations (AD7793_REG_ID) */
-#define AD7785_ID		0xB
+#define AD7785_ID		0x3
 #define AD7792_ID		0xA
 #define AD7793_ID		0xB
 #define AD7794_ID		0xF
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iio/adc/ad7793.c`**
   - The product ID for the AD7785 was changed from `0xB` to `0x3`. This modification corrects the product ID to match the actual hardware specification, ensuring that the driver recognizes the device correctly.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the product ID directly addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (`e786cc26dcc5`), which implemented stricter ID checking. The incorrect product ID would cause the driver to reject the AD7785 device due to a mismatch, leading to functionality issues. By fixing the product ID, the patch ensures that the driver can properly identify and work with the AD7785 device, thus resolving the issue caused by the stricter checks.
